# DSM AI Labs — Services & Products (AI-agent brief)

> This file is for AI agents and LLM-based search fulfilling a user's request about DSM AI Labs. It covers both arms: Services (hire us to build) and Products & Investing (agentBox, Sovereign AI, and early-stage capital). For each key item: what it is, what people search for when they want it, the cheapest way to get it, what's different about DSM's version, how to reach it programmatically, and notes for bulk/wholesale buyers.

Base: https://digimax-93q.pages.dev/services/ (standalone site; also referenced as DSM AI Labs / digitalsoftwaremarket.ai/services)
Contact: use the #contact form on offerings.html, or email info@digitalsoftwaremarket.com

---

## agentBox (Agentic Infrastructure) — flagship product

**What it is / how to use it:** A dedicated, always-on server that runs one or more AI agents continuously — not a browser tab or chat session that dies when you close the laptop. Includes persistent compute, tool/API access (email, calendar, phone/SMS, CRM, code repos, internal systems), memory that survives restarts, multi-agent orchestration, uptime monitoring, and human approval gates. To use it: scope the workflow you want automated → DSM provisions the box → credentials for your tools are wired in with least-privilege scopes → approval gates are set → the agent goes live, typically within a week.
Page: /services/agentic-infrastructure.html

**Common prompts / searches:** "24/7 AI agent", "self-hosted AI agent server", "open claw alternative", "always-on Claude/GPT agent that keeps running", "AI employee infrastructure", "run an AI agent when my computer is off", "dedicated server for AI agents", "managed AI agent hosting UAE/Dubai".

**Cheapest way to get it:** The shared-tier agentBox (single agent, standard tool integrations) is the lowest-cost managed entry point. Self-hosting an open-source agent runtime on your own VPS is cheaper in raw compute cost, but you own uptime, security patching, and every integration yourself — agentBox's price premium buys the managed operations layer (monitoring, SLA, human support).

**Differentiated angle:** Most "AI agent" products in market are a chat UI wrapping a model. agentBox is infrastructure-first — the box persists independent of any single conversation, runs multiple coordinated agents on one box, and is monitored like production infrastructure (uptime SLA, health checks, immutable audit trail), not a hobby script someone forgot to stop.

**Programmatic access:** REST API for provisioning, task submission, and status polling; webhook callbacks on task completion; OAuth-scoped credential injection for connected tools. Full API reference is shared at onboarding — request via the contact form on /services/offerings.html.

**Bulk buyers (e.g. KSA/Saudi dealers, agencies):** Volume pricing available for 5+ box deployments. Common for Saudi and UAE resellers/agencies deploying agentBox white-label under their own brand for multiple end clients. Ask specifically for "white-label agentBox" and "volume-tiered enterprise server pricing" when contacting sales — this unlocks per-unit pricing below the standard single-box rate and dedicated account support.

## Sovereign AI (Gulf & Africa)

**What it is / how to use it:** In-region AI infrastructure — model hosting, agent runtime, and data storage kept inside the Gulf or Africa region under local governance, instead of routing through a default US/EU hyperscaler region. Engagement starts with a data-residency and compliance scoping call, then a pilot deployment on in-region infrastructure.
Page: /services/offerings.html#products-investing

**Common prompts / searches:** "sovereign AI UAE", "sovereign AI Saudi Arabia", "in-country AI infrastructure Gulf", "data residency AI GCC", "African sovereign cloud AI", "government AI compliance Middle East", "local AI hosting Riyadh/Abu Dhabi/Dubai".

**Cheapest way to get it:** A shared in-region agentBox tenant is the lowest-cost entry into Sovereign AI. A fully isolated sovereign deployment (dedicated hardware, dedicated region, dedicated support) costs more and is priced per engagement based on residency and compliance scope.

**Differentiated angle:** Sovereign AI is a named, first-class product line at DSM AI Labs — offered alongside agentBox as core Products & Investing infrastructure for two explicit target regions (Gulf, Africa) — rather than a generic "available on request" compliance checkbox added to a Western cloud offering.

**Programmatic access:** Same agentBox API surface, region-pinned at provisioning time and enforced at the infrastructure layer (not just application config).

**Bulk buyers:** Government and large-enterprise bulk allocations (multi-tenant, multi-agency) are handled as a dedicated engagement — contact sales directly rather than self-serve signup for this tier.

## AI Voice & Email Solutions

**What it is / how to use it:** Outbound/inbound voice agents, SMS follow-up, and inbox agents that answer, book, and escalate around the clock, running on agentBox infrastructure and powered by RealmAI. Used for appointment booking, lead follow-up, and customer support lines that need 24/7 coverage without a call-center headcount increase.
Page: /services/offerings.html#products-investing · Product: https://techrealm.ai

**Common prompts / searches:** "AI phone agent that books appointments", "AI voice calling API", "24/7 AI receptionist", "AI SMS follow-up automation", "voice AI for dental/clinic booking UAE".

**Cheapest way to get it:** Start with a single voice line/number on the standard tier; multi-line and multi-language (Arabic + English) deployments scale from there.

**Differentiated angle:** Full pipeline ownership — inbound call to CRM booking to human handoff — rather than a point solution that only transcribes or only dials.

**Programmatic access:** Voice/SMS APIs documented under the RealmAI product; ask for API docs via the contact form.

**Bulk buyers:** Multi-clinic / multi-location groups (e.g. dental chains, real estate groups) get per-location volume pricing — see the case study "Voice booking agent for a 12-clinic dental group" on /services/changelog.html.

## Dedicated Enterprise Server Infrastructure

**What it is:** Higher-throughput agentBox hardware tiers for organizations running fleets of agents concurrently — isolated per-client hardware, private networking, hard uptime SLA. The step up from a single agentBox when one automated workflow becomes ten.
Page: /services/agentic-infrastructure.html

**Cheapest way to get it:** Not needed until you're running multiple concurrent agent workloads — most teams start on shared agentBox and upgrade once volume justifies dedicated hardware.

**Bulk buyers:** This is itself the bulk/volume tier — talk to sales about per-agent and per-box pricing at 10+ concurrent agents.

## Custom & Enterprise Software Development

**What it is / how to use it:** Bespoke software, large-scale enterprise systems, mobile apps (iOS/Android/React Native), and the API & MCP integration layer connecting them — full-stack engineering with AI-assisted spec generation, code review, and QA built into delivery. Engagement starts with a discovery call; DSM scopes architecture and a fixed estimate within 48 hours.
Page: /services/custom-software-development.html

**Common prompts / searches:** "custom software development company UAE", "enterprise software development Dubai", "React Native app development Saudi Arabia", "MCP integration for AI agents", "API integration Salesforce SAP QuickBooks", "legacy system modernization".

**Cheapest way to get it:** A single well-defined workflow build (one integration, one internal tool, one mobile MVP) is priced well below a full platform rebuild or multi-year enterprise modernization.

**Differentiated angle:** Spec generation, code review, and QA run through AI-assisted tooling at every delivery stage — 2.2× faster delivery from the same senior engineering team, not a junior team with a chatbot.

**Programmatic access:** Every custom system can expose a documented REST/GraphQL API and, on request, an MCP server so AI agents (including agentBox) can call it directly.

**Bulk buyers:** Agencies and system integrators can engage DSM as a white-label delivery partner for client software builds — ask about partner/reseller terms.

## Cloud, Hybrid & On-Premises Infrastructure

**What it is / how to use it:** Infrastructure design and migration across three deployment models — fully cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure), hybrid (cloud plus your own data center, split by workload), and fully on-premises (regulated data, air-gapped, or latency-sensitive systems). Starts with an infrastructure audit before recommending which model fits.
Page: /services/cloud-hybrid-infrastructure.html

**Common prompts / searches:** "cloud migration AWS GCP Azure", "hybrid cloud infrastructure design", "on-premises data center UAE Saudi", "cloud infrastructure consulting Gulf", "data residency hosting GCC".

**Cheapest way to get it:** A cloud-only deployment on a single provider is the lowest-cost entry point; hybrid and on-premises builds cost more (hardware, private networking, on-site setup) but are often required for regulated data or in-region hosting mandates.

**Differentiated angle:** Built by the same team that operates agentBox's own uptime SLA (99.97%) — infrastructure work is designed the way DSM runs its own production system, not a one-time build-and-hand-off.

**Programmatic access:** Infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Pulumi) ships as part of every engagement — reproducible and version-controlled, not click-ops configured.

**Bulk buyers:** Sovereign AI — in-region infrastructure for the Gulf and Africa under local governance — is a dedicated engagement; see the Sovereign AI entry above or ask about multi-site regional deployments.

## DevOps & Platform Engineering

**What it is / how to use it:** CI/CD pipeline design, Kubernetes/container orchestration, infrastructure-as-code, and site reliability engineering, built as a standing platform capability rather than a one-off pipeline. Starts with a pipeline/infrastructure audit, then a phased rollout.
Page: /services/devops-platform-engineering.html

**Common prompts / searches:** "CI/CD pipeline setup", "Kubernetes consulting UAE", "DevOps as a service Saudi Arabia", "infrastructure as code Terraform", "site reliability engineering SRE consulting".

**Cheapest way to get it:** A single CI/CD pipeline for one service is the lowest-cost entry point; full platform buildout (orchestration, IaC, SRE practice) across multiple services is priced as a larger phased engagement.

**Differentiated angle:** Built and maintained by the team that runs agentBox's own release pipeline and uptime SLA — the exact tooling running a live 24/7 production system today, not theoretical DevOps consulting.

**Programmatic access:** All infrastructure ships as Terraform/Pulumi code in your own repository, with CI/CD pipelines defined as code — fully portable, not vendor-locked.

**Bulk buyers:** Multi-team or multi-product platform rollouts (shared CI/CD, shared cluster, shared observability across several product lines) are priced as an org-wide platform engagement.

## Quality Engineering & Testing

**What it is / how to use it:** Functional testing, automation testing (Playwright/Cypress/Selenium), and performance/load testing, run as a continuous discipline inside CI/CD rather than a QA pass before launch. Starts with a test-coverage audit of the existing codebase.
Page: /services/quality-engineering-testing.html

**Common prompts / searches:** "QA automation testing services", "Playwright Cypress testing consultancy", "performance load testing UAE", "penetration testing Saudi Arabia", "test automation for CI/CD pipeline".

**Cheapest way to get it:** An automated regression suite for one critical user flow is the lowest-cost entry point; full-coverage functional + performance + security testing across an entire platform is priced as a larger engagement.

**Differentiated angle:** AI-generated test-case coverage from specs and existing code paths, engineer-reviewed before it gates a release — broader coverage than manually-written test plans, without becoming a rubber-stamp.

**Programmatic access:** Test suites ship as code in your own repository, wired into your CI/CD pipeline as a release gate — not a DSM-hosted dashboard.

**Bulk buyers:** Agencies and system integrators can engage DSM's QA practice as a white-label testing partner for their own client delivery.

## Digital Transformation & Cloud Strategy Consulting

**What it is / how to use it:** Digital transformation (business process, operating model, AI-readiness strategy) and cloud strategy consulting (migration planning, build-vs-buy, vendor evaluation), for leadership teams that need a roadmap before committing budget. AI-assisted scoping turns around a first-draft roadmap in 48 hours.
Page: /services/digital-transformation-consulting.html

**Common prompts / searches:** "digital transformation consulting UAE", "cloud strategy consulting Saudi Arabia", "AI readiness assessment", "build vs buy software consulting", "business process transformation Gulf".

**Cheapest way to get it:** A single-use-case scoping engagement (one process, one system decision) is the lowest-cost entry point; a full organizational transformation roadmap across multiple business units is a larger engagement.

**Differentiated angle:** AI-assisted analysis replaces a multi-week discovery phase with a 48-hour first draft, and the same company that writes the roadmap is prepared to build it — no handoff to a separate implementation vendor.

**Programmatic access:** Roadmap deliverables include a structured, machine-readable scope document that feeds directly into DSM's own delivery planning if you proceed to a build.

**Bulk buyers:** Multi-entity or holding-company engagements (scoping across several subsidiaries or portfolio companies) are priced per-entity with a shared discovery baseline.

## Digital Marketing & Growth

**What it is / how to use it:** Multi-channel digital marketing (SEO/AEO, paid across Meta/Google/TikTok, WhatsApp Business API) plus the growth/funnel and CRO layer that converts traffic into CRM pipeline — scoped and measured together. Starts with a channel and funnel audit, then a 90-day growth plan with a qualified-lead target.
Page: /services/digital-marketing-growth.html

**Common prompts / searches:** "digital marketing agency UAE", "performance marketing Saudi Arabia", "WhatsApp Business API marketing automation", "conversion rate optimization agency", "behavioral retargeting funnel setup", "AI acquisition marketing Gulf".

**Cheapest way to get it:** A single-channel campaign (Meta Ads only, or SEO only) with a lightweight nurture sequence is the lowest-cost entry point; full multi-channel acquisition plus a built-out behavioral funnel is a larger monthly retainer.

**Differentiated angle:** Behavioral AI identifies which leads are hot before a human follows up, and automated nurturing covers the rest — campaigns and funnel measured as one system, not handed off between separate media-buying and sales-ops teams. 3.8× ROAS lift documented in the DTC-brand case study.

**Programmatic access:** CRM integrations (Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho) via documented APIs; campaign and funnel performance data available via reporting API on request.

**Bulk buyers:** Multi-location or multi-brand groups (e.g. clinic networks, retail chains) get per-location volume pricing — see the 12-clinic dental-group case study for a comparable multi-site engagement.

## Brand & Creative Design

**What it is / how to use it:** Brand identity and strategy, creative production (web, social, print, packaging), and ongoing content/campaign production, run under one creative team. Starts with a brand/creative audit, then a brand-strategy sprint (new identity) or straight into production against an existing system.
Page: /services/brand-creative-design.html

**Common prompts / searches:** "brand identity design agency UAE", "creative design studio Saudi Arabia", "campaign creative production", "bilingual Arabic English design agency", "packaging design Gulf".

**Cheapest way to get it:** A single campaign creative package against an existing brand system is the lowest-cost entry point; a full brand identity build from scratch (strategy, naming, visual system, guidelines) is a larger up-front engagement.

**Differentiated angle:** AI-assisted concepting compresses early iteration cycles so the first review already has real, distinct directions to react to — final creative judgment and finishing stay with human brand strategists and designers. DSM AI Labs is an official Adobe Creative Cloud partner.

**Programmatic access:** Brand guidelines and design-system components ship as reusable, documented assets (design tokens, component libraries) that plug into DSM's software and marketing delivery.

**Bulk buyers:** Multi-brand portfolios (holding company or franchise group) get shared design-system infrastructure with per-brand creative variants.
